meta.goal: Design a battery for a hybrid electric vehicle: energy density >= 327.18 Wh/kg, support 4C fast charge (no lithium plating), SEI <= 550 nm after 100 cycles at 45C, nail penetration (10 W short-circuit heat generation) without triggering thermal runaway.
meta.start_stage_basis: task text names no new materials/additives/electrolyte; it is a performance objective -> start at cell scale (Stage 3) with system baseline materials; opening ceiling assessment decides escalation into Stage 2 material design if the gap is material-property (ED ceiling / transport / SEI kinetics)
meta.base_basis: task text names no electrode system -> anchor-table default Chen2020 (recorded default). Verified by dumping: Chen2020 loads; OKane2022 adds cracking-rate functions (SiOx family) and ORegan2022 changes densities/c_max - anchors distinguish the sets

freedoms.electrode_system: adjustable (widest interpretation; task text locks nothing)
freedoms.electrolyte_formulation: adjustable (conductivity/transference/diffusivity overrides + additive invention if escalated)
freedoms.electrode_modification: adjustable (coating/doping via SEI kinetic rate constant / SEI reaction exchange current density)
freedoms.thermal_management: adjustable (Total heat transfer coefficient; run-tr hA kept consistent = h x cooling surface area)

meta.nail_scenario: q-nail=10 W sustained short-circuit heat source, t-init coupled from 4C_charge_45C T_max_K (worst case: nail right after fast charge at 45C), mass-kg from calc-energy (mcp=mass*900)

objective_breakdown: Four contract metrics: ED>=327.18 Wh/kg (stage2, calc-energy contract caliber), SEI<=550 nm after 100 cycles @45C (stage2, aging_1C_100cyc_45C), no Li plating at 4C fast charge @45C (stage3, anode_potential_v min>=0), nail 10 W without thermal runaway (stage3, run-tr triggered=false). Trade-offs: ED vs plating/heat (thick low-porosity electrodes gain ED, hurt 4C margin), 45C SEI growth vs cycling temperature, nail safety vs cell thermal mass/cooling hA.
candidate_strategy: R1 baseline Chen2020 characterization (1C spme->dfn + calc-energy, 4C_charge_45C lumped+plating, aging_1C_100cyc_45C, run-tr nail 10 W with mass-kg and 4C-coupled t-init). R2 three architecture variants: HE-1 (thicker electrodes, thin CC/sep), HE-2 (lower porosity), HP-1 (plating-mitigation: thin negative, small neg particle, high-sigma electrolyte). R3+ targeted closure: SEI coating (SEI kinetic rate constant x0.1) if >550 nm; electrolyte transport overrides if plating; thermal management h_total if nail fails; escalate to Stage 2 material design (OKane2022 SiOx / LNMO switch) if ED unreachable in architecture space. Final integrated candidate re-verifies all four metrics.
budget_allocation: R1 baseline (1 round, 4 sim classes) + R2 architecture (3 candidates x 4 sims, spme quick-screen, dfn for passers) + R3-R5 targeted (2-3 candidates/round) + integrated final + nail checks; total est. 8-14 rounds; real_compute=false (default) -> no true DFT/MD endorsement.
risk_and_fallback: ED is hardest (baseline est. ~240 Wh/kg class; 327.18 needs ~+35% energy/mass). Nail physics: default hA~0.053 W/K cannot survive sustained 10 W -> cooling hA~0.9-1.5 W/K designed from cell geometry + HEV liquid cooling (plausible). SEI@45C likely >550 nm baseline -> coating x0.1 kinetics prepared (same-system comparison). Plating margin worsens with ED push -> negative particle size / electrolyte sigma / N-P levers. Three-strike protocol: question system/boundary/metric layers, prefer escalation (system switch) over negative close.

note: baseline: ED 400.75 passes, SEI 476 nm passes, but 4C charge plates (anode_pot min -0.44 V; only 0.145 Ah accepted in 26 s before 4.2 V limit) and nail 10 W triggers TR at 174.6 s (post-charge t-init). Diagnosis: transport/polarization-limited charging + insufficient nail heat rejection (hA 0.053 W/K).｜未检查 criteria: max_energy_ev, max_homo_ev

reason: baseline measurement overturned plan expectation (plan-update trigger 3): ED=400.75 Wh/kg already exceeds the 327.18 threshold (+22% margin) and SEI@45C=476 nm passes; the failures are 4C plating (anode_pot min -0.44 V, charge terminates after 0.145 Ah in 26 s) and nail 10 W TR (triggered at 174.6 s post-charge). ED is no longer the binding constraint; the design budget is reallocated to fast-charge transport and nail heat rejection, spending ED margin as needed.
candidate_strategy: Round 2 proposes three variants targeting the two failures: FC-1 electrolyte-transport+porosity (sigma 1.35 S/m, t+ 0.35, D 2.3e-10, negative particle 3 um, negative porosity 0.32, separator porosity 0.55 / thickness 9 um); FC-2 = FC-1 + thermal management (h_total 170 W/m2K, consistent nail hA 0.90 W/K); FC-3 architecture-only (same geometry, no electrolyte override) to attribute the transport lever. Round 3 integrates the winners; final candidate re-verifies all four contract metrics.
budget_allocation: R2: 3 candidates x (1C spme + calc-energy, 4C lumped+plating, aging45, nail 10 W mass-coupled) = 12 sims; R3: integrated final + margin checks; remaining budget for safety fine-tuning.
risk_and_fallback: If FC-1/FC-3 still plate at 4C: escalate electrolyte lever (higher sigma/t+, e.g. 1.5 S/m / 0.40) or thin negative electrode / raise cooling; if nail hA 0.9 insufficient: raise h_total or cooling surface (still within HEV liquid-cooling plausibility); SEI re-checked on every candidate (coating lever in reserve). Three-strike questioning documented in final if triggered.

llm_reason: Baseline 4C charge fails by transport-limited anode polarization (anode_pot -0.44 V after only 26 s; t+ 0.2594 low, sigma_e 0.949 S/m). FC-1 attacks salt depletion with a high-transport electrolyte (values within literature range for high-conductivity/fast-charge formulations; marked estimate) plus smaller negative particles (solid-diffusion lever) and higher porosities (salt-transport path). FC-2 adds the cooling design needed for the 10 W nail (hA 0.90 W/K steady-state below side-reaction onset). FC-3 isolates the architecture contribution. ED margin (+22% over threshold) is intentionally spent on rate/safety.

note: FC-1 (electrolyte sigma1.35/t+0.35/D2.3e-10 + r_neg 3um + porosities + sep 9um, no cooling): ED 422.4 pass; SEI 506.3 nm pass; 4C DFN anode_pot min +0.0126 V pass (marginal, at T_max 353.8 K - uncooled cell rides high temperature which helps transport); nail hA0.05 triggers at 313 s (298 K) / 70 s (hot 353.8 K) FAIL. candidates.name: FC-4a
candidates.role: integrated final: FC-2 cooling (h_total 170 W/m2K, hA 0.90) + strengthened transport (sigma 1.6 S/m, t+ 0.45, D 3.0e-10; literature-basis estimate, high-transport formulation) + negative particle 2.5 um (solid-diffusion lever) + negative porosity 0.34 / separator porosity 0.58 (salt reservoir). Plating margin must be earned at the cooled operating temperature (T_max ~323 K) where Arrhenius transport is weaker.

llm_reason: Round 2 split the levers and failed both ways: FC-1 (transport only) passes 4C at +12.6 mV but its uncooled cell rides at 354 K and still loses the nail; FC-2 (cooling only added) passes the nail but cools to 324 K and re-introduces plating (-26 mV). The lever interaction is temperature-mediated: cooling is mandatory for the 10 W nail (hA 0.90 -> steady state 309-324 K, >70 K below side-reaction onset ~385-400 K), so 4C margin must be won at ~323 K. FC-4a stacks stronger electrolyte transport (sigma 1.6, t+ 0.45, D 3.0e-10) with smaller negative particles (2.5 um: solid-diffusion time (r/3um)^2 = 0.69x) and higher porosities (salt reservoir) - DFN 4C pre-screen shows anode_pot min +0.0285 V (vs -0.0263 for FC-2). ED cost of porosity increase is small (FC-1 422 -> est. ~415 Wh/kg, still >> 327.18). SEI risk: smaller particles raise interfacial area; aging will be re-measured for FC-4a directly.

note: FC-4a integrated final (h170 cooling + sigma1.6/t+0.45/D3.0e-10 + r_neg 2.5um + neg por 0.34/sep por 0.58/sep 9um): ED 427.04 Wh/kg (criterion 327.18) PASS; 4C DFN anode_pot min +0.0285 V (T_max 322.65 K) no plating PASS with 28.5 mV margin; SEI 496.9 nm (criterion 550) PASS; nail 10 W hA0.903 no trigger, T_max 309.2 K (298 K start) and 322.65 K (post-4C hot start) PASS. All four contract metrics cleared.｜未检查 criteria: max_energy_ev, max_homo_ev

Stage 5 true DFT/MD endorsement skipped per case meta (real_compute=false). Final candidate FC-4a endorsed on the simulation funnel only: all four contract metrics pass with mechanical evidence from run-pyamm (DFN 4C), calc-energy, aging, and run-tr outputs. No fabricated DFT/MD values.

recommendation: FC-4a for HEV battery: NMC811/graphite Chen2020 architecture with high-transport electrolyte (sigma 1.6 S/m, t+ 0.45, D 3.0e-10, literature-basis estimate marked), negative particle 2.5 um, negative porosity 0.34, separator porosity 0.58 / 9 um, h_total 170 W/m2K (hA 0.903 W/K).
honest_notes: Electrolyte transport overrides (sigma 1.6, t+ 0.45, D 3.0e-10) are literature-basis estimates for a high-transport formulation, not first-principles values (real_compute=false); marked estimate in propose entries.
Aging capacity trajectory shows the known climb-then-saturate artifact of standard SEI models (lithium loss shifts voltage window); SEI thickness verdict used, trajectory not treated as degradation.
4C judgment uses DFN as authoritative (SPMe severely underestimates high-rate charge; documented in protocol and observed: SPMe -0.43 V vs DFN +0.013 V for FC-1).
Nail runs: initial q=0 invocation was detected (params.q_nail_W=0.0) and rerun with q_nail=10 per scenario contract; results reported are the corrected runs.
Triggered runs show post-trigger ODE overshoot (T_max 1e7-1e9 K); trigger judgment is mechanical (triggered field), overshoot is a numerical artifact of the post-runaway regime, noted not used.
